title: Run State, atomic persistence, and locking
objective: Implement per-run schema-validated State, Orchestrator-only writes, atomic transitions, locking, remote/local authority boundaries, no telemetry, and secret redaction.
acceptance_criteria: Each run State validates schema/version and persists every transition atomically under a lock.
Concurrent writer receives LOCK_BUSY; interrupted writes never leave partial JSON.
Only Orchestrator owns shared State writes; remote status is reconciled from GitHub before dependent actions.
No telemetry/analytics path exists and secret fixtures never appear in outputs/logs.
undo_classification: Preserve state and logs; only remove test-owned temporary files after ownership checks.
retry_policy: Initial attempt plus at most 2 retries; stop early for data-integrity uncertainty.
